issues: 灰底占位 dashboard，频闪前后画面都是灰条，没有“高潮前倒数”的对象
黑帧之间的画面没有任何变化，只有暗角在变，压强感很弱
落锤后只是放大到一张空白卡 + 细选中环，释放感不足
冷灰配色与靛蓝选中环平淡，没有预告片气质
changes: look 自定义（石墨近黑 + 信号红）：院线预告片式发布海报，2.39:1 遮幅黑边，居中 210px 超粗字标「PARALLAX」（虚构相机引擎），蓄压段是 SVG 遮罩做的干净空心描边
频闪即倒计时：黑闪 [44…83] 各 2f、间隔 8→3f 收敛，每闪右上 T–10→T–01 跳一格 + 刻度点亮；暗角 0.5→0.92、字标背后红色变形镜头光条随闪次拉长
落锤一帧四件事：零补间硬切 1.35×（CSS zoom 按目标尺寸栅格化）、遮幅撤掉、空心字变实心白、红光条炸满全宽，叠 2f 压暗 0.82
余波：「AVAILABLE NOW」升起、三项规格（8K / 240 fps / 0.9 kg）4f 错峰升起；光条 18f 衰减到 0.45
时间表 150f：0–30f 眉题字距收紧 + 空心字标 track 入场，全程 1.0→1.06 ease-in 蓄压推近，落锤后 40f hold 只留 2% 极缓推进
issuesEn: Grey placeholder dashboard: nothing on screen for the 'countdown before the climax' to be about
Between black frames the picture never changes, only the vignette does, so the pressure barely builds
The slam just zooms into an empty card with a thin selection ring; little release
Cool grey palette with an indigo ring: flat, nothing trailer-like
changesEn: Custom look (graphite near-black + signal red): a theatrical teaser poster with 2.39:1 letterbox and a 210px ultra-bold 'PARALLAX' wordmark (fictional camera engine), drawn as a clean hollow outline via an SVG mask during the build-up

The strobe is the countdown: black flashes [44...83], 2f each, gaps converging 8 to 3f; each flash ticks T-10 to T-01 and lights a pip, vignette tightens 0.5 to 0.92 and a red anamorphic streak grows behind the wordmark

The slam does four things in one frame: zero-tween hard cut to 1.35x (CSS zoom, rasterized at target size), letterbox removed, hollow wordmark turns solid white, red streak blows out full width, plus a 2f 0.82 darken
Aftermath: 'AVAILABLE NOW' rises, three specs (8K / 240 fps / 0.9 kg) rise 4f apart; streak decays to 0.45 over 18f
150f timeline: eyebrow tracking tightens and hollow wordmark tracks in over 0-30f, 1.0 to 1.06 ease-in push throughout the build, 40f post-slam hold with a 2% creep
